info.title: KTOB - Java Business API
info.description: R1 REST/JSON contract with 57 designed operations. Only operations in docs/implementation/implemented-operations.json are implemented; deployment and verification evidence is recorded separately. Supabase JWT authentication, owner-scoped private business data, archival preservation, independent per-reading half-star ratings/progress, and explicit per-call AI consent/spoiler policy. Optional AI, seller research and full account deletion remain gated until qualified.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client stable UUID per logical operation. Scoped to verified reader+method+path. Same key and identical request returns stored prior response; key with different body returns 409. Retain keys for at least 24h (PROPOSED).

post.description: Owner and request validation precede current AI-processing consent checks. Consent is rechecked immediately before every external dispatch. V3 context contains only the current question, minimal selected-book title/author/language and at most four complete permitted turns within 6000 UTF-8 bytes; no journal, reading history, profile, preferences or memories are read for context. On provider error no turn or idempotency result is committed. A UUID Idempotency-Key replays the same saved pair for the same canonical body/spoiler request; changed payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Fingerprints and message references are retained with the conversation for at least 24 hours. Missing consent returns 403 AI_PROCESSING_CONSENT_REQUIRED, unavailable/unqualified provider returns 503, and busy/quota state returns 429. Spoilers default to NO_SPOILERS. FULL_BOOK_SPOILERS requires fullBookSpoilersConfirmed=true in that request; inconsistent pairs return 422 SPOILER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED before dispatch. Both sides of previous FULL_BOOK_SPOILERS turns are excluded from later NO_SPOILERS context. Spoiler avoidance remains best effort. V3 creates no memory proposals and returns proposalIds=[].

201.description: Atomically persisted reader+assistant turn; V3 returns proposalIds=[] and creates no memory proposals.

422.description: Invalid request/spoiler pair (SPOILER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED) or required context exceeds the bounded budget (AI_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE); no provider call.

429.description: AI request is busy or provider quota is exhausted. Retry manually after the bounded Retry-After delay; no automatic provider retries.

Retry-After.description: Suggested delay in seconds before retrying; also exposed to the allowed browser origin.

post.description: No outbound AI call unless current aiProcessingOptIn is true immediately before dispatch. No private history unless personalizationOptIn, request opt-in, scope flags and journal exclusion all permit it. Unknown warning data never implies compliance with a firm boundary; return 403 for missing AI consent, 503 if provider unavailable. Spoilers: omitted spoilerLevel means NO_SPOILERS; FULL_BOOK_SPOILERS requires fullBookSpoilersConfirmed=true in the same request; reject otherwise with 422 SPOILER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED before any external AI call. Never infer permission from reading progress, chat history or user profile. Firm content boundaries still apply. The model cannot guarantee absence of all spoilers.

supabaseBearer.description: Supabase Auth user access token. Authorize ownership from verified subject.

ownerReaderId.description: Null for global OPEN_LIBRARY work; set only on the creator-visible MANUAL work. Never expose another reader's private work.

format.description: Null means unknown. OTHER means known format not in named categories.

displayName.description: Only editable R1 profile field. When optional onboarding is skipped, service assigns a neutral default Reader; no public profile, biography or age requirement.

ProfilePatch.description: Optional progressive onboarding: PATCH displayName only if reader chooses to edit. Profile auto-created on first authenticated access; no mandatory onboarding step.

shelfStatus.description: Derived from an open reading experience if one exists; otherwise the most recent closed experience by reading chronology, then createdAt, then UUID; or WANT_TO_READ if no experience.

rating.description: Optional per-reading-experience score in half-star steps from 1 to 5, or null if unrated.

progressPercent.description: Optional whole-number completion estimate 0..100; not auto-computed from page counts or audio length, and does not imply status transition. No requirement to set 100 when FINISHED; historical records can omit it.

ReadingExperience.description: Progress and rating are independent of reading status; no automatic conversion from edition length.

historicalImport.description: Required true for creating a historical reading experience directly with a terminal/paused status.

title.description: Omit or send null for a local default title; otherwise provide a nonblank title of at most 160 characters.

ConversationCreate.description: GENERAL has no workId. BOOK_MAIN requires a canonical work visible to the authenticated reader. Conversations are directly reader-owned and independent of library archive; they do not read stored journal or reading context in V3. Multiple conversations may reference the same work.

spoilerLevel.description: Effective policy for this turn. V3 records it on both reader and assistant messages; older contract consumers may omit it.

fullBookSpoilersConfirmed.description: True only if reader explicitly authorized FULL_BOOK_SPOILERS on this turn; absent on assistant messages.

spoilerLevel.description: NO_SPOILERS if omitted. FULL_BOOK_SPOILERS requires explicit fullBookSpoilersConfirmed=true in the same request.

fullBookSpoilersConfirmed.description: An explicit acknowledgement for this single request; never stored as a persistent account permission.

MessageWrite.description: Question must be nonblank and at most 12000 characters. V3 additionally bounds the complete provider context to 6000 UTF-8 bytes and returns 422 AI_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE rather than silently truncating the question. No stored personalization field is accepted or transmitted. Default NO_SPOILERS if omitted. FULL_BOOK_SPOILERS requires explicit true confirmation in the same request; it does not override AI-processing consent.

active.description: True only when proposal APPROVED and revokedAt null. Do not reactivate via PATCH.

boundaryExceptionIds.description: Explicit per-request exception IDs, authorized against reader-owned firm boundaries.

spoilerLevel.description: NO_SPOILERS if omitted. FULL_BOOK_SPOILERS requires explicit fullBookSpoilersConfirmed=true in the same request.

fullBookSpoilersConfirmed.description: An explicit acknowledgement for this single request; never stored as a persistent account permission.

RecommendationRequest.description: Default NO_SPOILERS if omitted. FULL_BOOK_SPOILERS is allowed only with an explicit true confirmation in this request; it does not override content boundaries or AI-processing consent.
